proposal.target_claim: README.md states that the current quillpad version is 0.1.0, which the bumped manifest version 0.1.1 contradicts.
proposal.rationale: The exemplar shows a document line carrying a project-version literal that goes stale when the project advances. I applied the same shape to the ordinary present-tense version statement in README.md and changed only the manifest's project version to the next patch value.
